messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 pager: high error rate and latency for hosted API (us-west-2). 15%+ 5xx on /v1/generate since 12:17 UTC. Paging oncall.
Sam (oncall): I'm on it, taking lead. Can someone confirm scope (internal + external customers)? @Maya please stand by for comms.
Priya (SRE): Seeing a spike in artifact fetch errors from S3: repeated `GET` 503/SlowRead from s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com for model shards. Stack traces show chained fallback timeouts.
Luca (Infra): Logs from pod-ml-03: `ERROR model_fetch: failed to stream shard 7, err=EOF after 12s` Also increased tail latency for KV cache warmups.
Sam (oncall): Immediate mitigation idea: route traffic for critical customers to us-east-1 pool + enable cached model variant (quantized v1-small) as fallback. Can infra push routing change?
Luca (Infra): I can flip a regional route rule. Will run `redwood route update --from us-west-2 --to us-east-1 --selector "tier=critical"` in 2m.
Priya (SRE): Also temporarily reduce model size for new requests: `model_selector: prefer: v1-small-quant` in runtime config. That should reduce shard fetches.
Maya (ProdOps): Drafting status page + customer note. Proposed status page update (short):
```
We are investigating elevated error rates and latency for the Hosted API in us-west-2. A subset of requests to the text-generation endpoints may see increased failures or delays. Our engineers are actively mitigating by routing traffic and enabling fallback model variants. We will post updates within 30 minutes.
```
Elena (Customer Success): Can you include a line for customers with reserved capacity? They need explicit mention if Dedicated is affected.
Priya (SRE): Quick note for vendor escalation: opened AWS support case 1234567891. Summary sent: repeated S3 5xx/slow reads in us-west-2 affecting object download for model shards; included logs and example request IDs.
Priya (SRE) -> AWS-Eng: Hi @AWS-Eng, can you confirm if there are any ongoing S3 control-plane or data-plane issues in us-west-2? Attaching sample request IDs: r1: 7d2f-abc, r2: 9a3b-def. Impacting model artifact fetch times ~10-20s.
AWS-Eng: Acked. We're looking into internal metrics for the region; will follow up in ~15m. Can you share `x-amz-request-id` values if possible?
Luca (Infra): Pushing route change now. Running dry-run, then promote.
Sam (oncall): Routing change applied for `tier=critical`. Monitoring metrics.
Priya (SRE): Enabling model fallback in the cluster for all routed traffic to reduce further fetches.
incident-bot: Automation: reroute job completed (job id rj-7741).
Sam (oncall): Initial impact assessment: ~8% of total requests affected overall, but for some customers on heavy long-context workloads error rate peaked at 22%. No data exfil detected.
Maya (ProdOps): Publishing status page update now (short) and pushing to subscribers. Customer notification (email/SMS template draft):
```
Subject: Service disruption affecting text-generation in us-west-2 (ongoing)

Hi — we are investigating a disruption affecting text-generation in our us-west-2 region. Some requests may fail or be delayed. We have routed critical traffic to an alternate region and enabled temporary model fallbacks to reduce impact. We will send another update in 30 minutes and share the root cause once known. If you have a dedicated deployment, your account team will reach out directly.

— Redwood Inference Ops
```
Elena (Customer Success): I'll queue targeted messages for impacted customers with reserved instances. Adding PS escalation for top 5 accounts.
Priya (SRE): AWS updated: "Investigating increased 5xxs on S3 data plane in us-west-2, internal team engaged. No broad control-plane outage detected."
Sam (oncall): OK, timeline: 12:17 UTC alert -> 12:20 routing change for critical customers -> 12:27 model fallback enabled -> 12:35 observed error rate down from 15% to ~4% for routed traffic.
Luca (Infra): Follow-up infra action: add cached model artifacts to local disk on inference nodes to avoid repeated S3 pulls (config change posted to runbook). Command snippet: 
```
# prefetch model shards
redwood infra prefetch --model v1-small-quant --nodes selector="pool=us-west-2-cache"
```
Priya (SRE): Filing mitigation notes for postmortem. Please capture times of routing, model switch, and AWS updates.
Maya (ProdOps): Comms update pushed to status.redwood.ai: Short notice + link to subscribe. I'll run a longer customer-facing post in 2 hours with RCA promised within 48 hours.
Sam (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline for next 45m, handing to Priya for incident continuation and vendor follow-ups. Priya please ack and take lead.
Priya (SRE): Ack. I'll continue the ticket and keep the channel updated. Assigning incident owner in tracker: priya-sev2-18325.
AWS-Eng: Update: we've seen elevated S3 tail latency correlating with a storage subsystem in us-west-2. We're applying mitigations; will advise when stabilized.
Priya (SRE): Noted. Action item: Add a short vendor comms template for future incidents (to use when opening cases). Draft: 
```
Hello AWS Support,

We're observing elevated 5xx and high latency for S3 object GETs in us-west-2 impacting model artifact fetches for Redwood Inference. Sample object keys: s3://redwood-models/.../shard-*. Request IDs: 7d2f-abc, 9a3b-def. First observed 2026-03-15T12:17Z. Impact: elevated client error rates (~15% peak) and increased service latency for hosted text-generation endpoints. Please escalate to platform storage and provide ETA for mitigation.

Thanks,
Redwood On-call
```
Elena (Customer Success): Saved — will reuse for customer-facing vendor updates if AWS provides a timeline.
Sam (oncall): Closing notes: current overall error rate down to 3.8% cluster-wide, us-west-2 still slightly degraded but routing+fallback minimized customer impact. Leaving incident channel open for follow-up and postmortem.
Maya (ProdOps): Postmortem owners: Priya (RCA), Luca (infra mitigations), Elena (customer comms + notification log). Target: preliminary postmortem in 48 hours.
Priya (SRE): Adding runbook improvement: add automated prefetch and regional reroute playbook.
incident-bot: Incident state updated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to SEV3 at 12:50 UTC.
Elena (Customer Success): I'll send a targeted update to affected enterprise customers now.
Sam (oncall): Thanks all. If AWS confirms fix, we'll schedule a brief ops sync to review the timeline.
AWS-Eng: Follow-up: we're seeing improvement metrics; storage team applied partial mitigation. Will keep you posted once fully validated.
